      - spent_bound: 0.0
      - completed: []
      - budget_stopped: false
  - pairs:
      for:
        value: item
        in: ${queue}
        steps:
        - budget_gate:
            switch:
            - condition: ${spent_bound + 15.2 > 40.0}
              assign:
              - budget_stopped: true
              next: break
        - pair_intent:
            call: http.post
            args:
              url: https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial/o
              auth:
                type: OAuth2
              query:
                uploadType: media
                name: ${item.prefix + "launch-intent.json"}
                ifGenerationMatch: 0
              body:
                rotation: ${item.rotation}
                spent_bound: ${spent_bound}
                reserved_pair_max: 15.2
              headers:
                Content-Type: application/json
        - run:
            call: run_pair
            args:
              job: ${item.job}
              job_id: ${item.job_id}
              label: ${item.label}
              prefix: ${item.prefix}
            result: outcome
        - require_success:
            switch:
            - condition: ${outcome.final_state != "SUCCEEDED"}
              raise: Pair did not complete. No paid retry or later rotation launched.
        - complete:
            call: http.get
            args:
              url: ${"https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial/o/"
                + text.url_encode(item.prefix + "complete.json")}
              auth:
                type: OAuth2
              query:
                alt: media
            result: completion
        - decode_complete:
            call: decode_document
            args:
              value: ${completion.body}
            result: complete_doc
        - freeze:
            call: http.get
            args:
              url: ${"https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial/o/"
                + text.url_encode(item.prefix + "selection-freeze.json")}
              auth:
                type: OAuth2
              query:
                alt: media
            result: freeze_response
        - decode_freeze:
            call: decode_document
            args:
              value: ${freeze_response.body}
            result: freeze_doc
        - completion_gate:
            switch:
            - condition: ${complete_doc.success != true or complete_doc.folds != 2
                or len(freeze_doc.selected) != 2 or freeze_doc.test_not_evaluated_yet
                != true}
              raise: Pair completion/selection barrier invalid
        - account:
            assign:
            - spent_bound: ${spent_bound + outcome.cost_bound_usd}
            - completed: ${list.concat(completed,item.rotation)}
        - record_pair:
            call: http.post
            args:
              url: https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial/o
              auth:
                type: OAuth2
              query:
                uploadType: media
                name: ${item.prefix + "queue-accounting.json"}
                ifGenerationMatch: 0
              body:
                outcome: ${outcome}
                spent_bound: ${spent_bound}
                completed: ${completed}
              headers:
                Content-Type: application/json
  - after_pairs:
      switch:
      - condition: ${budget_stopped}
        next: budget_stop
  - all_done:
      call: http.post
      args:
        url: https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial/o

  - done:
      return:

        spent_bound: ${spent_bound}
  - budget_stop:
      call: http.post

        url: https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial/o
        auth:
          type: OAuth2
        query:
          uploadType: media
          name: density36/flex-queue01/queue-complete.json
          ifGenerationMatch: 0
        body:
          completed: ${completed}
          spent_bound: ${spent_bound}
          reason: Insufficient allowance for another full pair maximum; no recipe
            reduction
        headers:
          Content-Type: application/json
  - stopped:
      return:
        completed: ${completed}
        spent_bound: ${spent_bound}
        reason: budget_gate
run_pair:
  steps:
  - initialize:
      assign:
      - deadline: ${sys.now() + 154800}
      - queue_deadline: ${sys.now() + 86400}
      - status:
          body:
            status:
              state: UNKNOWN
      - first_allocated: null
  - create:
      call: http.post
      args:
        url: https://batch.googleapis.com/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/locations/us-central1/jobs
        query:
          jobId: ${job_id}
        auth:
          type: OAuth2
        body: ${job}
      result: created
  - monitor:
      try:
        steps:
        - get_status:
            call: http.get
            args:
              url: ${"https://batch.googleapis.com/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/locations/us-central1/jobs/"
                + job_id}
              auth:
                type: OAuth2
            result: status
        - get_vm:
            call: list_resources
            args:
              label: ${label}
              kind: instances
            result: active_vms
        - reset_age:
            assign:
            - age_expired: false
        - check_vm_age:
            for:
              value: active_vm
              in: ${active_vms}
              steps:
              - first_allocation:
                  switch:
                  - condition: ${first_allocated == null or time.parse(active_vm.creationTimestamp)
                      < first_allocated}
                    assign:
                    - first_allocated: ${time.parse(active_vm.creationTimestamp)}
              - age_limit:
                  switch:
                  - condition: ${sys.now() >= time.parse(active_vm.creationTimestamp)
                      + 66600}
                    assign:
                    - age_expired: true
        - check:
            switch:
            - condition: ${status.body.status.state == "SUCCEEDED" or status.body.status.state
                == "FAILED"}
              next: record
            - condition: ${sys.now() >= deadline}
              next: record
            - condition: ${age_expired}
              next: record
            - condition: ${len(active_vms) == 0 and sys.now() >= queue_deadline}
              next: record
        - wait:
            call: sys.sleep
            args:
              seconds: 30
            next: get_status
      except:
        as: monitor_error
        steps:
        - monitor_failure:
            call: sys.log
            args:
              text: Monitoring failed; proceeding to cleanup
              severity: ERROR
  - record:
      try:
        call: http.post
        args:
          url: https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial/o
          query:
            uploadType: media
            name: ${prefix + "job-status.json"}
          auth:
            type: OAuth2
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: ${status.body}
      except:
        as: record_error
        steps:
        - record_failure:
            call: sys.log
            args:
              text: Could not persist final status; proceeding with cleanup
              severity: ERROR
  - delete_job:
      try:
        call: http.delete
        args:
          url: ${"https://batch.googleapis.com/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/locations/us-central1/jobs/"
            + job_id}
          auth:
            type: OAuth2
        result: deletion
      except:
        as: delete_error
        steps:
        - delete_failure:
            call: sys.log
            args:
              text: Batch deletion failed; checking workers directly
              severity: ERROR
  - cleanup_wait:
      call: sys.sleep
      args:
        seconds: 30
  - list_workers:
      call: list_resources
      args:
        label: ${label}
        kind: instances
      result: workers
  - delete_stragglers:
      for:
        value: vm
        in: ${workers}
        steps:
        - delete_vm:
            try:
              call: http.delete
              args:
                url: ${vm.selfLink}
                auth:
                  type: OAuth2
            except:
              as: cleanup_error
              steps:
              - check_cleanup_error:
                  switch:
                  - condition: ${map.get(cleanup_error, "code") != 404}
                    steps:
                    - rethrow_cleanup:
                        raise: ${cleanup_error}
  - verify_wait:
      call: sys.sleep
      args:
        seconds: 30
  - verify:
      call: list_resources
      args:
        label: ${label}
        kind: instances
      result: remaining
  - assert_empty:
      switch:
      - condition: ${len(remaining) > 0}
        raise: 'Cleanup incomplete: labeled workers remain'
  - disk_deadline:
      assign:
      - disks_until: ${sys.now() + 300}
  - verify_disks:
      call: list_resources
      args:
        label: ${label}
        kind: disks
      result: disks
  - disk_gate:
      switch:
      - condition: ${len(disks) == 0}
        next: done
      - condition: ${sys.now() >= disks_until}
        raise: Labeled disks remain after cleanup
  - disk_wait:
      call: sys.sleep
      args:
        seconds: 15
      next: verify_disks
  - done:
      return:
        mode: domain17
        final_state: ${status.body.status.state}
        workers_remaining: 0
        job_uid: ${created.body.uid}
        cost_bound_usd: ${if(first_allocated == null, 15.2, (sys.now() - default(first_allocated,sys.now()))
          * 0.8 / 3600 + 0.1)}
  params:
  - job
  - job_id
  - label
  - prefix
list_resources:
  params:
  - label
  - kind
  steps:
  - init:
      assign:
      - found: []
  - zones:
      for:
        value: zone
        in:
        - us-central1-a
        - us-central1-b
        - us-central1-c
        steps:
        - read:
            call: http.get
            args:
              url: ${"https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/zones/"
                + zone + "/" + kind}
              auth:
                type: OAuth2
              query:
                filter: ${"labels.trial_id = " + label}
            result: r
        - items:
            for:
              value: item
              in: ${default(map.get(r.body,"items"),[])}
              steps:
              - append:
                  assign:
                  - found: ${list.concat(found,item)}
  - done:
      return: ${found}
decode_document:
  params:
  - value
  steps:
  - map:
      switch:
      - condition: ${get_type(value) == "map"}
        return: ${value}
  - decode:
      return: ${json.decode(value)}
